Marissa / team -

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick responses:

- NDA: Redwood can typically turn an NDA review in 1-2 business days. If Acme wants a tracked redline back, plan for 2 business days. If it's a straight signature on our standard NDA with minor edits, we can expedite same day in many cases.
- MSA: 5-7 business days for an initial Redwood redline; if commercial terms require finance review (e.g., custom payment terms, PO exceptions), add 3-5 business days.
- DPA: we use a standard DPA; we can provide a draft in parallel to MSA negotiations.

Non-negotiables (flagging so sales can preempt):
- Data residency and encryption-at-rest clauses we keep (we can provide KMS/HSM integration details but typically do not change baseline language).
- Liability caps tied to fees - we can discuss but expect standard language.

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: send the NDA to Bob (done) and follow up if they want tracked edits vs comment-only
- David: prep the redacted SOC2 + questionnaire for 8/12 delivery
- Jonas: prepare a short tech note on expected latency profiles and pilot runbook

I'll be on standby to review MSA redlines once we get to that phase.

Vivek
